name: Time Bomb, Greater
body:
Source Ultimate Intrigue pg. 251
Aura strong evocation; CL 13th
Slot none; Price 6,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
A greater time bomb functions as a time bomb, but deals 13d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 20 half).
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, alarm, delayed blast fireball; Cost 3,000 gp
